items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: in those days, in Chicago, there was Davy Tough

ctx.x: Well Stanley and I have our archives together at Yale. And I insisted in having a mini- archive on Squirrel. Because although Stanley and I are supposed to be entirely black, we’re not entirely black, and in those days, in Chicago, there was Davy Tough, there was
Bud [Freeman], there was — well I didn’t know Teschemacher — but I mean it was a wonderful school.
